version: 0.4.0
kind: udi
schema_type: core

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.udi
  name: udi.schema
  description: Canonical schema defining UDI structure and validation rules.

spec:
  target_kind: udi
  naming:
    file_suffix: .schema.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:
  - name: pattern
    path: pattern
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: maxSegments
    path: maxSegments
    type: integer
    required: true

  - name: slugSeparator
    path: slugSeparator
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: allowSlugSeparator
    path: allowSlugSeparator
    type: boolean
    required: true

object:
  pattern: "^prismata\\.[a-z0-9-]+\\.[a-z0-9-]+\\.[a-z0-9-|]+$"
  maxSegments: 4
  slugSeparator: "|"
  allowSlugSeparator: true
